---
title: "Exercise: add a page"
extensions:
  atelier:
    duration: 1 h 30 min
---

This exercise makes you add a page to the site of the previous page.

## The task

::: {.exercise title="Add a page" duration="30 min"}

Make a new file `notes.qmd` in your site folder.
Give it a title and one paragraph of text.
Then add the page to the navigation in `_quarto.yml` and look at it in the preview.

:::

::: {.solution title="Hint"}

The navigation of the site is in the key `website.navbar.left` of `_quarto.yml`.
Add one item that has the key `href` with the value `notes.qmd`.

:::

::: {.solution}

## Full answer

Write this in `notes.qmd`.

```{.markdown filename="notes.qmd"}
---
title: "Notes"
---

My first note.
```

Then add `- href: notes.qmd` to `website.navbar.left` in `_quarto.yml`.

:::

## Check your work

Look at the preview.
The new page must show in the navigation, and its title must show at the top of the page.
